2026-08-27.patch_summary: This patch fixes a use-after-free (UAF) bug in the Linux kernel's memory cgroup (memcg) implementation. The bug occurs when the `drain_all_stock()` function is called asynchronously during offline operations, and it can lead to a situation where the memcg is freed while the drain work is still pending. To fix this issue, the patch modifies the offline path to wait for the completion of the workqueue before freeing the memcg. This ensures that the memcg remains valid until all pending work has been completed.
